integrationStatus: Integrated in Unity 6000.6.0f1: modeled held items and hands, memory guidance, talisman time stop and radial loadout. Focused rule/integration checks passed and a fresh Windows player built successfully; no native playthrough performed.
imageGenerator: Built-in image_gen for hand, incense and talisman. Existing project-owned HUD flashlight image reused byte-for-byte.
handedness: Generated reference shows left palm despite right-hand prompt; mirror the generated base locally for the opposite hand during rigging.

authoring.geometry: Source GLB welded across coincident UV seam vertices; original per-loop UVs retained. Mesh simplified, continuous normals recalculated. Hand source skin finished locally with shallower palm and slimmer digits at an 80,000-triangle target; five small keratin nail caps conform to the preserved distal skin and share its rig weights. No substitute base meshes.
authoring.handRig: 23 bones: 17 deform bones (wrist, palm, five three-joint fingers), five nondeforming fingertip markers and palm_contact. Measured digit centre lines; nearest-digit weights blended along knuckles with wrist/palm protection; five editable grip actions. Unity FBX coordinate conversion mirrors the generated surface; runtime mirrors once for the opposite hand.
authoring.fragments: Five source-derived paper strips with alternating slanted cuts, original UV/PBR retained.
authoring.gameMapImport: Original embedded 4096px maps kept. Unity hand maps and albedo-derived skin normal import at up to 4096px; other items import at up to 2048px.

skinDetail.method: High-pass luminance of the unchanged source albedo, Gaussian sigma 5px, gradient strength 1.4, tangent-space normal. Re-run after hand export; no new model generation.

nails.source: Originals/hand.glb distal finger surfaces after source-derived finishing
nails.method: Editable keratin caps follow the actual source skin using BVH ray projection, offset 0.35mm; same nearest-digit skin weights. Local finishing only; original GLB untouched.
